Every code block (s3-code, practice-folder, practice-answer-rule) shows its lines whole and unwrapped. metrics.json: overflowX false, 0 console, mermaid, unknown-block and broken-image errors.

textOnlyScreens is empty on both devices, and every concept section breaks its text with a definition, diagram, table, callout or check. The practice section runs about six mobile screens (mobile-jp-15 to 20). It has three separate one-step steps blocks (practice-steps, practice-steps-deny, practice-steps-bill), and each one restarts at ①.

The lesson is all Japanese, with no stray English UI strings. Inline code chips stay whole and readable, for example `--dangerously-skip-permissions` in e1 (mobile-jp-21.png). Contrast is good on the callouts, the dark code blocks and the quiz cards. No controls are hidden under the 56 px top bar or the 60 px bottom bar.

niceToHave: Line breaks at 390 px leave one or two characters alone on the last line. Examples: hook-predict option 2 ends with 「なる」 on its own line (pages/mobile-jp-02.png), s1-practices item 2 ends with 「い」 (pages/mobile-jp-04.png), and s3-check options 1 and 4 end with 「く」 (pages/mobile-jp-11.png, mobile-jp-12.png). Shortening the text a little would avoid these orphans, for example 「…そのまま流し込まない」 → 「…そのまま渡さない」.

The practice section shows three one-step 'steps' blocks (practice-steps, practice-steps-deny, practice-steps-bill). Each is headed 「1ステップ中 0 完了」 and numbered ① (pages/mobile-jp-16.png, mobile-jp-18.png). Merging them into one steps block numbered ①②③, with the code and prompt blocks between them, would show the order more clearly.

The s2-layers caption says VMs and cloud sessions enclose all of Claude Code, but the diagram has no box for that outer layer (pages/mobile-jp-07.png). An outer subgraph labelled 「VM・クラウドセッション」 would let the picture show this layer as well.
